A cyst of the prostate is confined to a reproductive organ outside the axes; urinary tract damage is not inherent.
STAR deficiency impairs adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis, causing classic adrenal insufficiency and sex-hormone deficiency.
Degenerative cervical vertebral and joint disease. Radiculopathy or myelopathy is not established in at least 30% by the supplied evidence.
Constitutional trisomy 8 commonly causes developmental and skeletal abnormalities; renal malformations occur in roughly 30–50%. Hematologic malignancy risk is excluded.
Nonsyndromic congenital extra digits; hand polydactyly is present in all three reported patients.
